operating_notes.text: DI pipe realization improved to ₹55,000/ton in Q1FY27 from ₹50,500/ton in Q4FY26
T.I.S. Services (Italy) delivered EUR 10 million revenue in Q1FY27 with EBITDA margin improving to mid-teens
Valve business targeting 20%+ YoY growth; expecting to double revenue from ₹400 Cr base in next four years
Postal ballot concluded on 13 August 2026: 38.01% of public institutional votes opposed the revision in tenure of Whole-time Director Priya Manjari Todi.
Acquired 70% of Arabian Water Tech LLC (Oman) for OMR 21,000 on 19 September 2026.

timeline.summary: Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,425.57 Cr (-8.5% YoY), net profit ₹48.37 Cr (-45.7% YoY).
Q1FY27 results: revenue ₹1,426 Cr; EBITDA ₹139 Cr (9.5% margin); PAT ₹48.4 Cr; order book 3 lakh tons (~5 months coverage)
Postal ballot approved re-appointment of Uddhav Kejriwal and tenure revision of Priya Manjari Todi, though 38.01% of institutional votes opposed Todi.
Completed acquisition of 70% shareholding in Oman-based Arabian Water Tech LLC for OMR 21,000.
